contracts.name: PeakParabolaFit
contracts.shows: Three adjacent log-magnitude samples define a concave fitted parabola whose vertex is one sixth of a grid bin from the largest sample and supplies a 0.25 dB fitted height.
contracts.alt: Three adjacent log-magnitude samples at minus twelve, zero, and minus six decibels lie on a concave fitted parabola with a vertex one sixth of a grid bin to the right of the center sample.
contracts.responsive: Plot and formula column stack below 560 CSS pixels; formula blocks have local horizontal overflow guards.

contracts.name: PhaseFalseResolution
contracts.shows: At fixed N=64, rectangular window, and true coordinates 10 and 10.5, relative phase alone changes one maximum at 10.25 into false maxima at 9.582764 and 10.917236.
contracts.alt: Two equal-tone spectra with identical frequencies and record length but different relative phase show one merged maximum in phase and two displaced maxima in quadrature.
contracts.responsive: The fixed-axis comparison panels stack below 560 CSS pixels and repeat truth guides in each panel.

contracts.name: LocalizationResolutionLedger
contracts.shows: The decision ledger assigns larger L plus interpolation to isolated-peak localization and larger N or a changed window/model to component separation.
contracts.alt: A decision ledger sends a fixed-record isolated peak to denser sampling and interpolation, but sends unresolved components to longer acquisition or a changed model.
contracts.responsive: Two self-contained cards stack below 640 CSS pixels; every card repeats claim, fixed evidence, action, changed quantity, and failure check.

implementation_audit.svg_use: curves, axes, guides, markers, and short plain-language labels only

iterations: First pass exposed a malformed TeX sample triplet and an uneven decision-card footer; both were corrected.
Second desktop pass found no clipping, collisions, broken TeX, spacing defects, or theme failures.
The 360-pixel pass found all plots, labels, formulas, repeated row headers, and verdicts legible without page-level horizontal scrolling.
